title: NATO to Skip 2027 Leaders' Summit in Albania as High-Level Meetings Scaled Back
detail: Albanian PM Edi Rama said in Dublin on Nov 13 that NATO's 2027 summit will not be held in Tirana, with no common position on timing and 2028 floated instead. A NATO official said the next summit 'will be held in Albania' with the date undecided. AP/ITV report the alliance is scaling back high-level meetings: no defence ministers' meeting was held in October 2026, none is scheduled for October 2027, and foreign ministers will meet once next year instead of twice. Allies reportedly object to Albania's defence spending (~2.15% of GDP); Reuters reported in June that US administration resistance had put the Albania plan in doubt. Rutte downplayed the change, saying summits can be arranged whenever necessary.

media.caption: Albania's PM says 2027 NATO summit will not be held in Tirana
